def axis(k, v, h):
    n = len(k)

    for i in range(n):

            A[i, 1 if i == 0 else n-2] = -k[i]/h**2
        else:

L = np.kron(np.eye(ny), ax) + np.kron(ay, np.eye(nx)) + np.diag(s['V_reaction_2d'].ravel(order='F'))
rhs = np.column_stack([m_.ravel(order='F') for m_ in s['source_modes']])
